meta.title: Paid Ads Plan: Landowner Listings
meta.headline: Spend ₹500/day on one Meta click-to-WhatsApp campaign for Karnataka landowners. Google Search waits as Phase 2 until budget grows and owners can list without an account.
meta.footer: Prepared by Iugale Services Pvt Ltd with the Ad Creation plugin v0.3.0. Benchmarks are planning estimates, not facts.

flows.goal: Landowners start a WhatsApp chat to list their farmland.

campaign.name: AGV | Meta | Leads | WhatsApp | KA Landowners
campaign.headline: Leads → WhatsApp
settings: Optimise for owners who message, not reach
One conversion location; tight control on a small budget
Housing is required only for US/Canada/Europe audiences; farmland sourcing isn't a home listing
Ads don't offer securities; keep return language out
raise: WhatsApp number live and answered within 5 minutes (+6)
notes: Blocker 1: no WhatsApp number on the site; replies promised within 24h.
Blocker 2: '500+ listings / 10K+ users' vs ~44 listings shown.
Blocker 3: confirm whether verification is free.

adsets.name: Karnataka landowners · broad
settings: Switch in a duplicate after 50+ if quality is poor
Karnataka · People living in · expansion OFF
Advantage+; exclude Audience Network, Messenger inbox
adsets.script:
Greeting: Hi Agrovest, I want to list my farmland for sale. [AGV-KA1]
Quick replies: Below 2 acres · 2-10 acres · 10+ acres · Just want a price estimate

First reply (within 5 min):
1. Greet in Kannada/English; confirm free listing, zero brokerage.
2. Village, taluk, district; acres; crop and water.
3. Land in your name / joint family / inherited?
4. 3-5 photos + RTC/Pahani photo (optional).
5. Expected price, or offer the AI estimate; timeline.
6. Agree next step: field visit or assisted listing.

ads.name: Broker commission pain
ads.why: Movement and a human face stop the scroll; the broker problem is felt, not read.
ads.prompt: Vertical 9:16 photoreal video, handheld phone feel, natural daylight. 0-2s: close-up of a 55-year-old Kannadiga farmer in a cotton shirt at the edge of his red-soil coconut farm, phone buzzing repeatedly. 2-7s: quick cuts of a dusty village road, a broker on a scooter pointing at the land, the farmer shaking his head. 7-10s: farmer sits on a stone bench and sends a WhatsApp message; his face relaxes. 10-12s: end card on forest green with a small Agrovest logo and a WhatsApp icon. Warm documentary tone, soft acoustic music. Avoid fake currency, other brands' logos, distorted hands.
ads.onscreen:
0-2s: ಬ್ರೋಕರ್ ಕಮಿಷನ್ 2-3%? (Broker commission 2-3%?)
7s: ಜೀರೋ ಬ್ರೋಕರೇಜ್ (Zero brokerage)
End card: Agrovest-ನಲ್ಲಿ ಉಚಿತವಾಗಿ ಲಿಸ್ಟ್ ಮಾಡಿ (List free on Agrovest)
ads.primaryText:
ನಿಮ್ಮ ಜಮೀನು ಮಾರಾಟಕ್ಕೆ ಬ್ರೋಕರ್ ಬೇಡ. Agrovest-ನಲ್ಲಿ ಉಚಿತವಾಗಿ ಲಿಸ್ಟ್ ಮಾಡಿ, 100% ಹಣ ನಿಮ್ಮದೇ. 👉 WhatsApp ಮಾಡಿ.
(No broker needed to sell your land. List free on Agrovest; 100% of the money is yours.)
ads.headline: Sell Your Farmland. Zero Brokerage.
ads.outcome: Highest hook rate and volume; may attract curious owners. Judge on cost per conversation and qualified %.
ads.policy: No return or guaranteed-price claims; no unverified buyer counts.

ads.name: 3-step verified process
ads.why: Shows exactly what happens after the message, removing the 'is this a scam' fear.
ads.prompt: Vertical 9:16 video, clean and bright. 0-2s: phone screen showing a WhatsApp chat opening with 'Hi Agrovest, I want to list my land'. 2-6s: an Agrovest field officer in a green polo walking a mango orchard with a tablet, photographing a borewell and boundary stone. 6-10s: officer checks a land record printout with the owner at a village house. 10-13s: animated listing card with 'Agrovest Score' and a verified tick. 13-15s: end card. Captions on every beat. Real Karnataka village, red soil, coconut and mango trees. No readable document numbers or names.
ads.onscreen:
1. WhatsApp ಮಾಡಿ (WhatsApp us)
2. ಫೀಲ್ಡ್ ವೆರಿಫಿಕೇಶನ್ (Field verification)
3. 48 ಗಂಟೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಲೈವ್ (Live in 48 hours)
ads.primaryText:
3 ಸರಳ ಹಂತ: WhatsApp ಮಾಡಿ → ನಮ್ಮ ತಂಡ ನಿಮ್ಮ ಜಮೀನನ್ನು ಪರಿಶೀಲಿಸುತ್ತದೆ → ಖರೀದಿದಾರರಿಗೆ ಲಿಸ್ಟಿಂಗ್ ಲೈವ್.
(3 simple steps: WhatsApp us → our team verifies your land → listing goes live to buyers.)
ads.headline: We Verify. You Sell. No Broker.
ads.outcome: Fewer but warmer conversations; best for qualified %.
ads.policy: Only claim free verification once confirmed.

ads.name: Free listing offer
ads.why: A clear offer card tests the core proposition in isolation and is fast to produce.
ads.prompt: Photoreal 4:5 image: wide golden-hour shot of a green arecanut and coconut farm in Karnataka with red-soil paths; top third clear sky for text. Lower third: soft forest-green gradient band. Editorial, aspirational, not stock-looking. Small Agrovest logo bottom-left. Export a 9:16 version with text inside the central safe zone.
ads.onscreen:
ಜಮೀನು ಮಾರಾಟ? ಉಚಿತ ಲಿಸ್ಟಿಂಗ್ (Selling land? Free listing)
₹0 ಬ್ರೋಕರೇಜ್ · ಫೀಲ್ಡ್ ವೆರಿಫಿಕೇಶನ್ · AI ಬೆಲೆ ಅಂದಾಜು
ads.primaryText: ಕೃಷಿ ಜಮೀನು ಮಾರಾಟ ಮಾಡಬೇಕೇ? Agrovest-ನಲ್ಲಿ ಉಚಿತ ಲಿಸ್ಟಿಂಗ್ + AI ಬೆಲೆ ಅಂದಾಜು. WhatsApp-ನಲ್ಲಿ ವಿವರ ಕಳುಹಿಸಿ.
ads.headline: Free Farmland Listing + Price Estimate
ads.outcome: Baseline performer; cleanest read on whether the offer works.

ads.name: Inherited village land
ads.why: Speaks to Bangalore professionals holding inherited village land.
ads.prompt: Photoreal 4:5 image: a 40-year-old Indian professional on a Bangalore apartment balcony at dusk, laptop open, looking at a phone photo of his family's ancestral farmland (paddy field, tiled-roof farmhouse). City lights behind. Warm, reflective mood. Top 25% clear for text. No brand logos on devices.
ads.onscreen:
Own ancestral farmland back home?
Sell it without weekend trips to the village.
ads.primaryText: Inherited farmland in your native village? List it free on Agrovest. Our field team visits, verifies and photographs it, so you don't have to travel. Zero brokerage. WhatsApp us your land's location.
ads.headline: Your Village Land, Sold Without the Travel
ads.outcome: Higher-value owners, better reply rates; smaller audience.

ads.name: Documents objection
ads.why: Documents are the #1 reason owners delay; a swipe sequence answers it step by step.
ads.prompt: Four 4:5 cards, flat-lay photo style on a wooden table. 1: stack of generic land papers (no readable text) with reading glasses. 2: phone sending a WhatsApp photo. 3: field officer's hand with a checklist. 4: green 'Listing Live' badge over a farm photo. Forest-green accents; one short line per card.
ads.onscreen:
C1 ಡಾಕ್ಯುಮೆಂಟ್ ಪೂರ್ಣವಾಗಿಲ್ಲವೇ? (Documents not complete?)
C2 RTC/ಪಹಣಿ ಫೋಟೋ ಕಳುಹಿಸಿ (Send an RTC/Pahani photo)
C3 ಏನು ಬೇಕು ಎಂದು ನಾವು ಹೇಳುತ್ತೇವೆ (We tell you what's needed)
C4 ನಂತರ ಉಚಿತ ಲಿಸ್ಟಿಂಗ್ (Then a free listing)
ads.primaryText: ಜಮೀನಿನ ದಾಖಲೆಗಳ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಗೊಂದಲವೇ? RTC/ಪಹಣಿ ಫೋಟೋ WhatsApp ಮಾಡಿ, ಯಾವ ದಾಖಲೆ ಬೇಕು ಎಂದು ನಮ್ಮ ತಂಡ ತಿಳಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.
ads.headline: Not Sure About Your Papers? Ask Us.
ads.outcome: Unlocks hesitant owners; slower to convert. Judge on conversations with documents shared.

Fix or cut if > ₹4,500 at day 30

blocks.title: Top 3 blockers
items: WhatsApp number live and answered within minutes, in Kannada and English.
Fix site claims: '500+ verified listings / 10K+ users' vs ~44 listings and many 'Verification Pending'.
Confirm what's free (verification, Agrovest Score) before ads promise it.

blocks.title: Assumptions
items: No offer beyond what the site states.
No past ad data (no Agrovest ads in Meta Ad Library).

blocks.title: Channel-role plan
rows: Landowners are on Facebook/WhatsApp; WhatsApp replies must be fast
Capture intent for 'sell my land' queries
Deferred: Phase 2 when Meta cost per qualified listing ≤ ₹3,500
Revisit only for a B2B land-aggregator offer
Not planned (test line ≤10% only if awareness is the goal)
Hub: form, WhatsApp button, tracking, retargeting pool
Tracking must be verified before spend
Tiny budget, no own data, WhatsApp not set up, claims mismatch
→ ~75 with WhatsApp staffed, claims fixed, 2 weeks of data
